newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Head of Congo Kinshasa news agency arrested.
newsitem.headline: Head of Congo Kinshasa news agency arrested.

text.p: The head of Democratic Republic of the Congo's news agency has been detained in connection with reports of the arrest of the country's finance minister, agency staff said on Saturday.
They told Reuters that Ali Kalonga, acting general manager of Agence Congolaise de Presse, was taken away from his office last Monday by a group of soldiers with an arrest warrant.
"Of course, his arrest has something to do with the story of the finance minister," one source said.
The agency, quoting judicial sources, reported last week that Finance Minister Mawampanga Mwana Nanga had been placed under house arrest on allegations of embezzlement.
But the government dismissed the report as "groundless rumour" and said Mawampanga was still minister.
The ACP report had centred on the seizure last month of $4.5 million in U.S. dollars and zaires -- the local currency -- at Kinshasa's Ndjili International Airport.
The source of the money, which was about to be shipped out of the country, has not been established.
Despite the government denial, finance ministry sources said on Saturday that Economy Minister Pierre Victor Mpoyo was acting as finance minister.
